Great Taco Soup
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:33am

Ingredients




2 pounds hamburger meat browned
2 can ranch-style beans
2 can whole kernel corn
2 can diced stewed tomatoes
1 can Rotel tomatoes
1 pkt Ranch Style Dressing Mix
1 pkt Taco Seasoning

Preparation

1 Into your crockpot pour the all of the above ingredients. 2 Simmer on LOW until ready, about 5 to 8 hours. Great to put on in the morning before work. Will be ready and delicious when you get home. 3 Serve with grated cheese on top and tortilla chips.
